answer_text: The alternate UDP port for DTLS tunnels is 1337. It is recommended in locations with restrictive networks (for example, China) where UDP 443 can have connectivity issues; by default DTLS uses 443 and will fall back to 1337 when connectivity problems are experienced. To enable it, use System Settings > Alternative DTLS Port and turn on the setting; note that enabling this may cause a brief DTLS tunnel reconnection. The knowledge base does not list any version prerequisites for this feature.
